{{Quote|I am the darkness, the all consuming horror, the ultimate fear!|The dark side entity, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="TOP" />}}
This '''dark side entity''' appeared in a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] to a young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during his [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I shall consume you, smother you in hate and fear, in blood and tears. You are mine, Anakin Skywalker, forever and for always.|The dark side entity, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="TOP" />}}
[[File:Unidentified_dark_side_entity_2.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The dark side entity appears in front of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]]]
Sometime after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], during a lesson with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] being [[Telekinesis/Legends|choked]] by something he could not see.<ref name="TOP" />

That night, feeling a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Skywalker left his [[Jedi Temple dormitory|dormitory]] and went to the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|Jedi Council Chamber]], where this dark side entity appeared in front of him. Activating [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]], Skywalker [[Duel in the Jedi Council Chamber|engaged]] the entity in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] and questioned it on its motives. The entity then told him that he would turn to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="TOP" />

[[File:Duel_in_the_Jedi_Council_Chamber.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The dark side entity battles Anakin]]
Foreshadowing [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|his future attack]] on the Jedi Temple, a group of defenseless [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|younglings]] materialized in the Jedi Council Chamber. The entity told Skywalker that he could not save them, and that their fate was already sealed. The entity then subjected him to [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. As he was losing all hope, Skywalker intuitively used [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]] to call out to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who heard his desperate plea far across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Focusing on his close friend, Skywalker filled up with energy of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] and destroyed the entity.<ref name="TOP" />

Following the incident, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], warned by [[Tiplee/Legends|Tiplee]], found his apprentice in the Jedi Council Chamber. The exhausted Padawan was then taken to his room, where he fell [[Sleep/Legends|asleep]]. In the corridor, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] explained to Kenobi that Skywalker had experienced a powerful [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] and that perhaps, in [[Time/Legends|time]], they would understand it.<ref name="TOP" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|You do not understand the power of the dark side&hellip; yet!|The dark side entity, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="TOP" />}}
[[File:Unidentified_dark_side_entity_4.jpg|thumb|right|225px|The dark side entity is destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] use of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]]]
This dark side entity wielded a [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. It was skilled in [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force choke]] and [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], two [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] mostly used by practitioners of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. It also proved to be impervious to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] attacks while he was in a state of anger. However, the entity disappeared when Skywalker employed the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] after reaching out to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] by [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]].<ref name="TOP" />

==Behind the scenes==
This dark side entity first appeared in ''[[Temple of Phantoms]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] written by [[Christopher Cooper]] and illustrated by [[Bob Molesworth]], which was published in [[2014]] in ''[[Star Wars Comic 7.9]]''.<ref name="TOP" />
